pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ caṇḍakāliṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpeti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ caṇḍakāliṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ caṇḍakāliṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ caṇḍakāliṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:2.1.19: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:2.1.23: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
